items.exampleEn: We play volleyball on the beach.
Let's go to the cinema tonight.
This TV program is very funny.
The children play in the yard.
My grandma tells me a story every night.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶每天晚上講故事給我聽。

items.sentenceEn: Our team plays volleyball on Friday.

items.audioEn: The cinema is near the park. The movie starts at seven.
items.audioZh: 電影院在公園附近，電影七點開始。

items.sentenceEn: Our team plays a game every Friday.
items.sentenceZh: 我們隊每個星期五都有比賽。

items.stemEn: There are six players on a volleyball ____.
items.stemZh: 一支排球隊有六名球員。

items.stemEn: Can you read me a ____ before bed?
items.stemZh: 你可以在睡前唸個故事給我聽嗎？

items.passageEn: It is Saturday. Sara and her friends do many fun things today. In the morning, they play volleyball, and their team wins the game! In the afternoon, they go to the cinema. In the evening, they watch a funny TV program at Sara's home.
items.passageZh: 今天是星期六，Sara 和朋友做很多好玩的事。早上他們打排球，他們的隊伍贏了比賽！下午他們去電影院。晚上他們在 Sara 家看一個好笑的電視節目。

referenceEn: Let's go to the cinema tonight.
Let's go to a movie tonight.
rubricZh: 「去看電影」可用 go to the cinema、go to the movies、see a movie 等

items.instructionZh: 用 game 造一個句子，說說你喜歡玩或看的遊戲、比賽。
referenceEn: I like to play games on my phone.
I watched a baseball game yesterday.
rubricZh: 「玩遊戲」可用 play a game、play games
